# sigma_jwk_set_key (Resource)

An additional key in a JWK set, for rotation. Sigma creates it inactive; set `active = true` to make it the set's signing key (the previous key stays, inactive, until deleted). A set holds at most two keys. There is no deactivate call: a key stops being active only when another key is activated, so after rotating again set the superseded key's `active` to `false` (or remove it), or the two keys will take the active role from each other on every apply. The active key can't be deleted, so destroying it only removes it from state, and `-replace` on an active key fails (the set would need a third key). Composite ID `<jwk_set_id>:<key_id>`; import the set's first key this way to delete it after rotating.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Rotation: stage a new key (inactive), register its public_key with the IdP,
# then set active = true. The previous key stays, inactive, until deleted.
resource "sigma_jwk_set_key" "next" {
  jwk_set_id     = sigma_jwk_set.snowflake.id
  valid_for_days = 365
  active         = false
}

# To delete the set's original key after rotating, adopt it, apply, then remove
# this block and apply again:
import {
  to = sigma_jwk_set_key.original
  id = "${sigma_jwk_set.snowflake.id}:<original-key-id>"
}

resource "sigma_jwk_set_key" "original" {
  jwk_set_id = sigma_jwk_set.snowflake.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `jwk_set_id` (String) JWK set the key belongs to.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this key signs for the set. Only `false` → `true` can be applied; activate a different key to deactivate this one.
- `valid_for_days` (Number) Certificate lifetime in days (Sigma defaults to 365). Used only at creation; changing it later has no effect.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_id` (String) JSON Web Key ID.
- `public_key` (String) PEM X.509 certificate. Never includes private key material.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_jwk_set_key.example '<jwk_set_id>:<key_id>'
```
